001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
004import java.util.Set;
005import java.util.function.Consumer;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.ExtendedFieldPrefix;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.JSONToken;
019
020/**
021 * A JSON encoder in
022 * <a href="https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/ecs-logging/java/current/index.html">Elastic
023 * Common Schema (ECS) logging format</a>.
024 * <p>
025 * Two shapes are supported, controlled by {@link #structured()}:
026 * <ul>
027 * <li><strong>Flattened (default)</strong>: field names are the flattened, dotted ECS
028 * field names (e.g. <code>"log.level"</code>) rather than nested JSON objects, matching
029 * how the reference <a href="https://github.com/elastic/ecs-logging-java">
030 * ecs-logging-java</a> implementation serializes them.</li>
031 * <li><strong>Structured</strong> ({@link EcsEncoderBuilder#structured(Boolean)
032 * structured=true}): fields are nested JSON objects (e.g.
033 * <code>"log":{"level":...}</code>), matching
034 * <a href="https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference/features/logging.html">Spring
035 * Boot's ECS structured logging format</a>.</li>
036 * </ul>
037 * Key values are written as top-level fields using their own key name, except a key value
038 * named like a field this encoder writes (e.g. <code>message</code>), which goes in a
039 * nested <code>keyValues</code> object, or is prefixed with <code>keyValues.</code> in
040 * the flattened shape, so no field is written twice.
041 */
042public final class EcsEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer> {
043
044        /**
045         * ECS encoder URI scheme.
046         */
047        public static final String ECS_SCHEME = "ecs";
048
049        /**
050         * The ECS schema version this encoder targets.
051         */
052        public static final String ECS_VERSION = "1.2.0";
053
054        private final @Nullable String serviceName;
055
056        private final @Nullable String serviceVersion;
057
058        private final @Nullable String serviceEnvironment;
059
060        private final @Nullable String serviceNodeName;
061
062        private final @Nullable String eventDataset;
063
064        private final boolean structured;
065
066        private final KeyValuesWriter keyValues;
067
068        private final boolean prettyPrint;
069
070        private final int maxBufferSize;
071
072        private static final DateTimeFormatter timeFormatter = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_INSTANT;
073
074        EcsEncoder(@Nullable String serviceName, @Nullable String serviceVersion, @Nullable String serviceEnvironment,
075                        @Nullable String serviceNodeName, @Nullable String eventDataset, boolean structured, boolean prettyPrint,
076                        int maxBufferSize) {
077                super();
078                this.serviceName = serviceName;
079                this.serviceVersion = serviceVersion;
080                this.serviceEnvironment = serviceEnvironment;
081                this.serviceNodeName = serviceNodeName;
082                this.eventDataset = eventDataset;
083                this.structured = structured;
084                this.keyValues = structured ? STRUCTURED_KEY_VALUES : FLATTENED_KEY_VALUES;
085                this.prettyPrint = prettyPrint;
086                this.maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize;
087        }
088
089        /**
090         * Whether fields are nested JSON objects (Spring Boot's ECS shape) instead of the
091         * default flattened, dotted field names (the reference ecs-logging-java shape).
092         * @return true if fields are nested.
093         */
094        public boolean structured() {
095                return this.structured;
096        }
097
098        /**
099         * Creates an ECS encoder using a lambda for easier registration. The builder will
100         * have properties loaded after the consumer has configured the builder.
101         * @param consumer lambda to configure builder.
102         * @return ECS encoder provider.
103         */
104        public static LogProvider<EcsEncoder> of(Consumer<EcsEncoderBuilder> consumer) {
105                return (s, c) -> {
106                        var b = new EcsEncoderBuilder(s);
107                        consumer.accept(b);
108                        return b.fromProperties(c.properties()).build();
109                };
110        }
111
112        /**
113         * Creates ECS Encoder.
114         * @param name property name prefix.
115         * @param serviceName <code>service.name</code> field, or null to omit.
116         * @param serviceVersion <code>service.version</code> field, or null to omit.
117         * @param serviceEnvironment <code>service.environment</code> field, or null to omit.
118         * @param serviceNodeName <code>service.node.name</code> field, or null to omit.
119         * @param eventDataset <code>event.dataset</code> field, or null to omit.
120         * @param structured <code>true</code> nests fields as JSON objects (Spring Boot's ECS
121         * shape) instead of flattened dotted field names, default is false.
122         * @param prettyPrint <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
123         * @param maxBufferSize maximum buffer size - a soft ceiling checked between events,
124         * not a hard cap enforced on any single event (see
125         * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.Buffer#isOversized()}). A negative value
126         * (the default) disables this entirely.
127         * @return encoder.
128         */
129        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX + "ecs.")
130        static EcsEncoder of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable String serviceName,
131                        @Nullable String serviceVersion, @Nullable String serviceEnvironment, @Nullable String serviceNodeName,
132                        @Nullable String eventDataset, @Nullable Boolean structured, @Nullable Boolean prettyPrint,
133                        @Nullable Integer maxBufferSize) {
134                prettyPrint = prettyPrint == null ? false : prettyPrint;
135                structured = structured == null ? false : structured;
136                int _maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize == null ? -1 : maxBufferSize;
137                return new EcsEncoder(serviceName, serviceVersion, serviceEnvironment, serviceNodeName, eventDataset,
138                                structured, prettyPrint, _maxBufferSize);
139        }
140
141        @Override
142        protected JsonBuffer doBuffer(BufferHints hints) {
143                return new JsonBuffer(this.prettyPrint, ExtendedFieldPrefix.AT, maxBufferSize);
144        }
145
146        @Override
147        protected void doEncode(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer) {
148                buffer.clear();
149                var formattedMessage = buffer.getFormattedMessageBuilder();
150                event.formattedMessage(formattedMessage);
151
152                int index = structured ? encodeStructured(event, buffer, formattedMessage)
153                                : encodeFlattened(event, buffer, formattedMessage);
154
155                if (index > 0 && prettyPrint) {
156                        buffer.writeLineFeed();
157                }
158                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_END);
159                buffer.writeLineFeed();
160        }
161
162        private int encodeFlattened(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer, StringBuilder formattedMessage) {
163                var now = event.timestamp();
164                var t = event.throwableOrNull();
165
166                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_START);
167                int index = 0;
168                index = buffer.write("@timestamp", timeFormatter.format(now), index);
169                index = buffer.write("log.level", LevelFormatter.toString(event.level()), index);
170                index = buffer.write("message", formattedMessage.toString(), index);
171                index = buffer.write("ecs.version", ECS_VERSION, index);
172                index = buffer.write("service.name", serviceName, index);
173                index = buffer.write("service.version", serviceVersion, index);
174                index = buffer.write("service.environment", serviceEnvironment, index);
175                index = buffer.write("service.node.name", serviceNodeName, index);
176                index = buffer.write("event.dataset", eventDataset, index);
177                index = buffer.write("log.logger", event.loggerName(), index);
178                index = buffer.write("process.thread.name", event.threadName(), index);
179
180                if (t != null) {
181                        index = buffer.write("error.type", t.getClass().getName(), index);
182                        index = buffer.write("error.message", t.getMessage(), index);
183                        var stackTrace = new StringBuilder();
184                        ThrowableFormatter.appendThrowable(stackTrace, t);
185                        index = buffer.write("error.stack_trace", stackTrace.toString(), index);
186                }
187
188                index = keyValues.write(event.keyValues(), buffer, index);
189                return index;
190        }
191
192        private int encodeStructured(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer, StringBuilder formattedMessage) {
193                var now = event.timestamp();
194                var t = event.throwableOrNull();
195
196                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_START);
197                int index = 0;
198                index = buffer.write("@timestamp", timeFormatter.format(now), index);
199
200                int logIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("log", index, 0);
201                logIndex = buffer.write("level", LevelFormatter.toString(event.level()), logIndex, 0);
202                buffer.write("logger", event.loggerName(), logIndex, 0);
203                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
204                index++;
205
206                index = buffer.write("message", formattedMessage.toString(), index);
207
208                int ecsIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("ecs", index, 0);
209                buffer.write("version", ECS_VERSION, ecsIndex, 0);
210                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
211                index++;
212
213                boolean hasService = serviceName != null || serviceVersion != null || serviceEnvironment != null
214                                || serviceNodeName != null;
215                if (hasService) {
216                        int serviceIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("service", index, 0);
217                        serviceIndex = buffer.write("name", serviceName, serviceIndex, 0);
218                        serviceIndex = buffer.write("version", serviceVersion, serviceIndex, 0);
219                        serviceIndex = buffer.write("environment", serviceEnvironment, serviceIndex, 0);
220                        if (serviceNodeName != null) {
221                                int nodeIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("node", serviceIndex, 0);
222                                buffer.write("name", serviceNodeName, nodeIndex, 0);
223                                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
224                        }
225                        buffer.writeObjectEnd();
226                        index++;
227                }
228
229                if (eventDataset != null) {
230                        int eventIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("event", index, 0);
231                        buffer.write("dataset", eventDataset, eventIndex, 0);
232                        buffer.writeObjectEnd();
233                        index++;
234                }
235
236                int processIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("process", index, 0);
237                int threadIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("thread", processIndex, 0);
238                buffer.write("name", event.threadName(), threadIndex, 0);
239                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
240                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
241                index++;
242
243                if (t != null) {
244                        int errorIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("error", index, 0);
245                        errorIndex = buffer.write("type", t.getClass().getName(), errorIndex, 0);
246                        errorIndex = buffer.write("message", t.getMessage(), errorIndex, 0);
247                        var stackTrace = new StringBuilder();
248                        ThrowableFormatter.appendThrowable(stackTrace, t);
249                        buffer.write("stack_trace", stackTrace.toString(), errorIndex, 0);
250                        buffer.writeObjectEnd();
251                        index++;
252                }
253
254                index = keyValues.write(event.keyValues(), buffer, index);
255                return index;
256        }
257
258        private static final KeyValuesWriter FLATTENED_KEY_VALUES = new KeyValuesWriter(KeyValuesWriter.Placement.DOTTED,
259                        Set.of("@timestamp", "log.level", "message", "ecs.version", "service.name", "service.version",
260                                        "service.environment", "service.node.name", "event.dataset", "log.logger", "process.thread.name",
261                                        "error.type", "error.message", "error.stack_trace"),
262                        0);
263
264        private static final KeyValuesWriter STRUCTURED_KEY_VALUES = new KeyValuesWriter(KeyValuesWriter.Placement.NESTED,
265                        Set.of("@timestamp", "log", "message", "ecs", "service", "event", "process", "error"), 0);
266
267}
